title: @Rose Theatrics #caroleking
transcript: So last night was our opening night of Beautiful, The Carole King Musical. And it was also the first time in over 25 years that my mother has seen me in a musical. And she was there in the front row with my husband, my sister in law and a few really dear friends. And throughout the show, she was bobbing her head, singing along. She knew all the song. She's having a great time. And everyone was like, she's having a great time. And no one thought to ask any questions. And then when the bows happened and everyone left the stage, my mom turned to my sister in law and said, is it over? And they said, yeah. And she's like, well, Bob hasn't been on stage yet. When is he come out? No, my part in the show might not be huge, but I had about 30 minutes of stage time as Donnie Kirstner, the record producer. And I was a righteous brother. And I was six feet from her singing directly to her at one point, no, granted, this is what I look like. I have a wig, but is it that confusing? And she was so upset because she missed me in the show even though I was.
